versions.changelog: Add auto-ensure-session (self-drive one-time device login; no auth dead-stop).

Initial release of media-studio-metered.

- Launches a pay-per-render media generation pipeline with image, video (async), and text-to-speech support.
- No user-provided provider key required; all billing is handled through SettleMesh.
- First call to each official capability is free; durable output links included.
- Allows storage and serving of outputs via integrated object storage commands.
- Enables reselling of AI-generated media with support for end-user billing and flexible markup.
- Requires settlemesh CLI and SETTLE_API_KEY for authenticated metered access.
